title: Ugaritic texts summoning dead Nephilim

tellings.quote: We know because there are eucharitic texts that have been discovered that have uh that have summoning rights that are summoning dead Nephilim.

plain: Ancient writings from the city of Ugarit, in the old land of Canaan, are said to contain rites for summoning the dead Nephilim, the giants spoken of in the Bible. Tim Alberino, a researcher who says a 12-foot giant was captured in Afghanistan, states this without naming where he read it. He offers it as proof that ancient people treated the giants as real.
